About

AbyssLog logs each of your Abyssal Deadspace runs, including tier, weather, ship class, duration, and outcome. Your cargo hold and drone bay are compared before and after each run to track what you looted and what you consumed.

Every run is appraised against Jita market prices via Janice, giving you an accurate ISK value for loot gained and items spent. Deaths are logged with a full loss estimate covering cargo, fit, and implants. The statistics page gives you ISK/hour, survival rate, and a breakdown by tier, weather, and ship class.
